· The top of the industry list was already the top of ours — forecasting and inventory 8/8,
 recommendations 7/8, chatbots 6/8. That is confirmation, not new information.

2 · Pricing is the biggest hole: 4 sources including Oracle's entire product line, and the
 loudest numbers in the whole set. Neither earlier folder touched it. → I01

3 · Oracle's page is worth more than the other seven combined for gap-finding — it names
 operational products, not themes. Four of the eight new plans came from that one page.

4 · Sustainability turns out to be a pricing problem: near-expiry stock is either marked down
 at the right time or written off. → I02, an extension of I01, with a hard KPI.

5 · Every source's CHALLENGES list says the same thing — review AI decisions, measure real
 business impact, privacy. Not one of them says model accuracy. → I06" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="268" width="780" x="40" y="1024" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c428" parent="1" div.div:
1 · The top of the industry list was already the top of ours — forecasting and inventory 8/8,
recommendations 7/8, chatbots 6/8. That is confirmation, not new information.
2 · Pricing is the biggest hole: 4 sources including Oracle's entire product line, and the
loudest numbers in the whole set. Neither earlier folder touched it. → I01
3 · Oracle's page is worth more than the other seven combined for gap-finding — it names
operational products, not themes. Four of the eight new plans came from that one page.
4 · Sustainability turns out to be a pricing problem: near-expiry stock is either marked down
at the right time or written off. → I02, an extension of I01, with a hard KPI.
5 · Every source's CHALLENGES list says the same thing — review AI decisions, measure real
business impact, privacy. Not one of them says model accuracy. → I06

div.div:
26 distinct industry use cases. 21 planned, or deliberately declined with a reason.
All eight sources are vendor or vendor-adjacent marketing — six are product pages.
Their statistics are evidence of what the market is BUYING, not of what will happen here.
Quote them with attribution and pair each with our own measured baseline.
That is exactly what I06 exists to produce.
